jobs.name: btc-price
jobs.prompt: Fetch the current Bitcoin price in USD — use web_fetch on https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd (or any live source if that fails). Reply with exactly one line in the format: BTC $<price> USD (timestamp UTC). No other text.

jobs.name: host-health
jobs.prompt: Daily host health check. Run these with the bash tool (skip any that are not installed): uptime; df -h /; free -h 2>/dev/null || vm_stat; sensors 2>/dev/null || vcgencmd measure_temp 2>/dev/null || echo "no temp sensor". Then reply with a three-line summary for the owner: (1) load average versus core count and any temperature reading, (2) root disk use percent with a warning above 80%, (3) memory pressure. Flag anything abnormal with a short recommendation. Keep it under 80 words.
